# MV3 compose send tests associate result messages with the sending tab

Each onAfterSend test message includes the sending tab ID. The harness resolves each compose window to a tab and waits on that exact message name, so results from a different window cannot satisfy the same generic wait. It opens the second window and obtains its ID before terminating the event-page backgrounds; the subsequent send is the intended wakeup. Existing direct mode/details assertions remain. This test association does not prove the reported duplicate-event hypothesis or a production data leak.

Scope: extensions/compose-tests.
